name: chmod-plus-x-with-octal-filename-is-not-gated
note: GUARD: a file named like an octal (777) appears as the second argument; the MODE position (first non-flag arg) is +x, which is not world-writable, so bash-chmod-world-write-mode anchors to the mode and does NOT over-gate. Fails closed to gommage; it does NOT become an ask_picto for fs.chmod:dangerous.
